/approve: Demo mode: nothing was sent. In the real app, approving runs exactly the tool call shown on the card (for a Slack or Gmail message it creates a draft for you to send), logs it to the audit trail, and archives the card.
/reject: Demo mode: rejected (nothing changes here). In the real app a rejection with a reason becomes a correction the system learns from; see Self-learning.
/revise: Demo mode: in the real app the drafter rewrites the card using your note and puts the new version back in the queue for approval. Nothing is ever sent from a revise.
/save-edit: Demo mode: your edit would replace the drafted text on the card. It still waits for your approval.
/mark-handled: Demo mode: marked handled. In the real app this archives the card and closes the task.
/add-task: Demo mode: in the real app this goes to the inbox and the next poll turns it into a task.

/chat.default: Demo mode: this is a saved reply, not a live model. In the real app the chief of staff answers from your knowledge graph and connectors (read-only), and anything it wants to do outside goes to the approval queue first.
/chat.urgent: Saved reply: Due today: the API v1 deprecation notice text for Tomas. Overdue: booking the laptop swap (Oct 9) and sending Grace Liu your updated resume (Oct 1). Alex needs the billing cron schedule by Thursday, Oct 16. Drafts for the notice, the cron reply and the resume are in the approval queue.
/chat.missed: Saved reply: In the real app this starts the correction loop. It looks for the item you say was missed, works out why the crawl missed it (a connector not searched, a rule that dropped it, a stale status), changes the cause, re-runs, and records the lesson. Three past corrections are shown under Self-learning.
/chat.waiting: Saved reply: You are waiting on IT for access to the analytics replica (RTA-90). Nothing else is blocked on someone else right now.

/entry-chat.default: Saved reply: In the real app you can discuss any task or draft here. The assistant reads the sources behind it and can change its notes, priority or status for you; it cannot send anything from this box.

/action-update: Demo mode: in the real app this updates the task (title, notes, priority or done) and records the change.
/poll-now: Demo mode: no polls run here. In the real app this checks each connected account for new items since the last poll.
/start-research: Demo mode: the research crawl already ran on this fictional world; this page shows its recorded result.
